description.zh: 看清圆环和手柄的比例，再继续核对下载入口与条款。 以单枚图标和主题套组组织的图标素材库，当前页面包括搜索、无线网络、时钟与博客组件等图形。官网条款署名 Min Kim，允许个人与商业项目使用，但原样再分发、转售及冒称作者受限；整体价格未确认，下载文件尚未实取。
description.en: An icon library organized into individual icons and themed sets, including search, wireless, clock, and blog-component graphics. Official terms credit Min Kim and permit personal and commercial projects, with restrictions on redistribution as-is, resale, and claiming authorship. Overall pricing is unverified; downloaded files have not been obtained.
